items.desc: The open agent skills tool - npx skills
Open-source local AI audio & music studio for macOS & Windows. TTS, voice cloning, songs with lyrics, and multi-track scores — 100% offline, zero API fees.
Let an AI model use a real iPhone with a $7 ESP32: AirPlay eyes, USB HID hands, any OpenAI-compatible vision model. No Mac, no developer account, no jailbreak.

37 tok/s from Qwen3-Next-80B (48 GB) on a 32 GB laptop, 24 without drafts vs 2.8 for llama.cpp; reading 62 vs 16 tok/s. Faster than llama.cpp on all 13 models compared in Q4_K_M. LLMs bigger than your RAM, pure C, CPU or GPU.

Turn your documents into a Markdown wiki that answers with citations. Runs locally with Ollama or any LLM provider. CROW classifier routing: 89% right note vs 62%, 2.1× faster ingest, 68% fewer tokens.
